verdict.rationale: Linear ships its own agent, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question to ask. The evidence only documents Linear's own MCP server, which external clients such as Cursor, Claude and v0 connect to. That is the opposite (server) role and earns no credit here. Nothing shows Linear Agent or any other Linear feature registering third-party MCP servers or calling their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
